proof_body:
by
  intro G _ _ p _ N P hN hp
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hp.exists_le_sylow
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq G Q P
  rw [← hg, Sylow.coe_subgroup_smul]
  intro x hx
  rw [Subgroup.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨g⁻¹ * x * g, hQ ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hN.conj_mem x hx g⁻¹
  · simp [MulAut.smul_def, MulAut.conj_apply]; group
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (N : Subgroup G) (P : Sylow p G), N.Normal → IsPGroup p N → N ≤ P
